lines.speaker: Goliath
lines.text: Why do you stand there in battle ranks? Choose your champion. Send one man down to face me!

lines.speaker: Goliath
lines.text: If your champion wins, we will serve you. If I win, you will serve the Philistines!

lines.speaker: Goliath
lines.text: I challenge the armies of Israel today! Send me a man. Let us fight!

lines.speaker: Soldier
lines.text: Fall back! Stay behind the line!

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Who is this Philistine to speak against the armies of the living God?

lines.speaker: Eliab
lines.text: Why are you here, David? Who is watching those few sheep? You only came to see the battle.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: What have I done now? May I not ask a question?

lines.speaker: Soldier
lines.text: The king should hear what this young shepherd is saying.
